A session at our group meeting about my day at the R Dev Day held alongside RSECon25. R Dev Days are short events, usually one day, where new and experienced contributors work together on contributions to base R, with support from the R Core Team.

The session covered:

- how the day is organised: a shared list of open issues on documentation, translation, I/O and low-level code, each with a facilitator and contributors;
- the issue I worked on, [#27](https://github.com/r-devel/r-dev-day/issues/27), reported by Henrik Bengtsson. In R a connection is identified by a small integer that gets reused, so after `close(con1)` a new connection can take the same number and `con1` silently points to it. Writing to `con1` then writes to the wrong file. Every connection also has a unique internal `id`, visible through the `conn_id` attribute, and that is what can tell the two apart;
- [VS Code Live Share](https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/services/live-share/), which lets several people edit and debug the same code at once from their own machines.
